title: Turing-profile-v1.0 void receipt
description: Written by turing-cal-eval when a check refuses BEFORE any score exists (the attempt is VOID, no verdict). File <out>/void_receipt_<n>.json, n = attempt number = first free number, exclusive create, never overwritten. A retry must repeat attempt 1 byte for byte (command and inputs fields); at most 3 attempts, and the third void attempt also writes final_receipt.json (terminal_receipt schema, verdict INCONCLUSIVE, reason INFRA). Refusal codes: calibration/docs/EVALUATOR.md section 3; rule: calibration/docs/FAILURE_REPORTING.md section 2.

command.description: argv joined by single spaces (quote and backslash replaced by an apostrophe)
